goal: Stop anonymous Tor peers from inheriting whitelist permissions assigned to the local Tor daemon
Ensure inbound Tor connections are correctly classified when automatic Tor listening is active
agreement: Concept or approach approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, winterrdog, vasild)
Resolved objection on wildcard onion binds retaining IP permissions (jeanpablojp)
Nonblocking concern that rejecting wildcard binds impairs container environments (schildbach)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents anonymous Tor peers from accidentally gaining privileged whitelist permissions
Eliminates peer misclassification when automatic Tor listening shares the main socket
